name: 04-upload-without-file-part
description: Without a 'file' part, inboundAttachments['file'] is null and the expression-component fails: default exception strategy answers 500 and nothing is written.

source.reference: http-multipart-request/src/main/app/http-multipart-request.xml (message.inboundAttachments['file'].dataSource... on a missing attachment throws; no exception strategy in processFileFlow)

request.body:
--PARITYBOUNDARY
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="other"; filename="other.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain

file uploaded
--PARITYBOUNDARY--
